blind.description: A square wooden card table with a stylized, hand-painted texture. The tabletop features a recessed dark green felt playing surface framed by a brown wood border with circular cup or token indentations at each of the four corners. A small drawer with a round brass knob is set into one side of the apron. The table rests directly on four carved square-section wooden legs with flared feet.
blind.from_above: A square wooden frame enclosing a dark green felt square, with circular dish-like depressions carved into all four corners.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 to 2.5 feet tall (roughly one-third to slightly under half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 to 3 feet wide on each side.
